I genuinely enjoy being part of something that brings our community together, and I’d love to contribute to making this year’s shows a great experience for everyone.
column15:
I’d love to build stronger connections within the South Asian community in Toronto. Being away from home, events like these feel meaningful, they celebrate our culture in such a vibrant and modern way. Contributing to that feels special.

On a personal level, I’m looking forward to growing my leadership and collaboration skills, learning how to handle real-time challenges during live events, and working alongside passionate, driven people who care about community impact.
